alternativeExplanations.title: Why the $7$ disappears
steps: Adding $7$ slides the whole graph up without changing any slope.
The derivative measures slope, so a constant contributes $0$.
Only the $4x^3$ and $-2x$ terms carry slope: $12x^2 - 2$, which is $46$ at $x = 2$.
